title: Penalties.
bodyText: In the case of a violation of this article, a licensee may be penalized in accordance with section 431:2-203.
bodyHtml: [§431:3B-105]  Penalties.  In the case of a violation of this article, a licensee may be penalized in accordance with section 431:2-203. [L 2021, c 112, pt of §2]
